display.purpose: Hero headline only; one per page.

headline.purpose: Section H2s; every one carries a keyword.

body.purpose: DM Sans paragraphs, 65-75ch max; white/80+ on green, never gray.

label.purpose: Uppercase eyebrow kickers and proof lines; 0.22em tracking.

shadows.name: gallery-frame
shadows.purpose: Featured lane portraits at rest — a mounted print. Pairs with a 1px black/5 ring.

shadows.name: hover-lift
shadows.purpose: Interactive cards on hover, usually with translateY(-4px). The only motion-shadow.

shadows.name: green-glow
shadows.purpose: Service-card hover; brand-tinted, never plain black.

motion.name: ease-settle
motion.purpose: Default easing for reveals and entrances — settles, never bounces.

motion.name: reveal-up
motion.purpose: Scroll-triggered section reveals, staggered 0.1s per sibling.

motion.name: hero-rise
motion.purpose: One choreographed hero entrance per page load.

motion.name: hover-zoom
motion.purpose: Images inside photo tiles on hover.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The booking CTA — Rojas Green pill, deepens to Forest Ink on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--color-primary, #1F6B4D); color: #fff; padding: 16px 40px; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-primary-dark, #0f2e1e); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-primary, #1F6B4D); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action — green border, fills green on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: transparent; color: var(--color-primary, #1F6B4D); padding: 12px 32px; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; border: 2px solid var(--color-primary, #1F6B4D); border-radius: 9999px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--color-primary, #1F6B4D); color: #fff; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-primary, #1F6B4D); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Inverse Button
components.description: The CTA on green bands — white pill, Forest Ink text.
components.css: .ds-band-demo { background: radial-gradient(90% 140% at 50% -30%, rgba(255,255,255,.1), transparent 60%), linear-gradient(160deg, #1F6B4D 0%, #0f2e1e 80%); padding: 32px; border-radius: 12px; display: inline-block; } .ds-btn-inverse { background: #fff; color: var(--color-primary-dark, #0f2e1e); padding: 16px 40px; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-inverse:hover { background: #f3f4f6; }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: DM Sans link with a scaleX green underline on hover.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { position: relative; display: inline-block; color: #1a1a1a; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; padding-bottom: 4px; } .ds-nav-link::after { content: ''; position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 2px; background: var(--color-primary, #1F6B4D); transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-nav-link:hover::after { transform: scaleX(1); }

components.css: .ds-card-green { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; width: 260px; height: 280px; padding: 28px; border-radius: 12px; text-decoration: none; background: radial-gradient(120% 80% at 85% -10%, rgba(255,255,255,.14), transparent 60%), linear-gradient(160deg, #1F6B4D 0%, #0f2e1e 100%); transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), box-shadow 0.3s; } .ds-card-green:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0,0,0,0.25); } .ds-card-green-chip { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2); } .ds-card-green-body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; } .ds-card-green-title { color: #fff; font-family: 'DM Serif Display', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.25rem; } .ds-card-green-desc { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8); font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-card-green-link { color: #d1fae5; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-card-green:hover .ds-card-green-link { text-decoration: underline; }

narrative.overview: This is the design language of executive confidence: a well-appointed office rendered as a website. Deep green leather, serif numerals, framed portraits on quiet walls. The photography — real clients, real light — carries every page; the design's job is to hang it well and stay out of the argument. Whites and warm papers do the walls, Rojas Green does the upholstery, and DM Serif Display speaks only when something deserves letterhead. The system is quiet and confident: soft pill buttons, gentle lifts on hover, one green voice used with intent.
keyCharacteristics: Photography-first: full-bleed portraits and image tiles do the visual heavy lifting
One committed brand color (Rojas Green) with a dark forest anchor and a mint whisper for accents on green
Serif display voice reserved for headings and numerals; humanist sans for everything read
Flat at rest; depth appears only as a response to hover or as a gallery frame
Motion is choreographed once (hero entrance), then restrained

rules.name: The One Green Rule
rules.body: Every green on the site comes from the Rojas Green ↔ Forest Ink ramp. No second green, ever. Green bands are the brand moments; between them, pages stay paper-quiet so the portraits win.

rules.name: The Bloom Rule
rules.body: Green surfaces are never flat fills. They carry the signature gradient: a subtle white radial bloom at the top edge over a 160deg Rojas Green → Forest Ink linear gradient.

rules.name: The Serif Speaks Rule
rules.body: DM Serif Display appears only in headings and featured numerals. It never sets a paragraph.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: If an element casts a shadow while nobody is interacting with it, it must be a photograph. Everything else earns depth through hover.

dos: Do let photography carry every section that has any — the design frames; it does not perform.
Do answer "individual or team?" within the first viewport of any page, with one CTA path for each.
Do use the Bloom Rule gradient on every green surface, and Mint Whisper — never gray — for secondary text on green.
Do keep AA contrast everywhere: Slate Body (#374151) is the floor for paragraph text on light ground; white/80 is the floor on green.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion for every entrance and reveal.
Do give every image descriptive, keyword-bearing alt text.
donts: Don't let anything read as discounted or volume-cheap — the team lane is a different experience, never a cheaper Signature.
Don't put prices in page titles or meta descriptions.
Don't reach for ornate, couture, fashion-house luxury — no filigree, no script faces, no drop caps.
Don't rebuild the old failure: six equal service cards competing at once.
Don't introduce a second accent hue, use Gold Star outside testimonial stars, or set gray text on green ground.
Don't animate layout properties; transforms and opacity only.
Don't use solo "I" voice anywhere in UI copy — "we, Alfonso & Niomi," always.
